d: A Diwali celebration in Seattle was targeted by far-right activist Jake Lang and protesters carrying racist, anti-Hindu placards, including calls to deport Indians. The incident sparked a confrontation, with attendees pushing back against the demonstrators. Lang later posted abusive remarks targeting Hindus, drawing condemnation from Indian-American leaders and the Coalition of Hindus of North America, which called it “Hinduphobic bigotry”.
